title: Uniform convergence of diffusion synthetic acceleration for heterogeneous slab transport
summary: The diffusion synthetic accelerated (DSA) source iteration is a standard solver for the radiative transfer equation. Using Fourier analysis, a convergence rate \(ρ_\infty(c)\le0.2247\,c\) with \(c\) the maximum ratio of scattering to total cross section has been established for an infinite homogeneous medium. For slab geometry with inflow boundary conditions and arbitrary bounded cross sections we prove that the spectral radius of the DSA iteration is at most \(ρ_\infty(c)\).
